description: Argentine consumer price inflation from INDEC: latest monthly %, year-over-year %, last 12 months, and optionally the compounded cumulative inflation between two months with an amount adjusted for inflation (rent, salary, price updates). Send {} or {from: YYYY-MM, to: YYYY-MM, amount}. Source failure = no charge. Paid tool: 0.002 USDC per call via x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana, no account or key). An unpaid call returns a payment-required result (isError, structuredContent with x402Version 2 and accepts); sign one of the accepts and retry the same call with the PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Returns JSON text; the settlement is in result._meta["x402/payment-response"].
name: ar_inflacion
title: Argentina inflation (INDEC)
